# Tree Weaver

> Tree Weaver is a visual builder for responsive web layouts. A forest (project) holds trees (layouts); a tree is made of branches (HTML or SVG elements with classes, attributes, per-display styles and children) and leaves (text, images or SVG shapes). Documents are plain JSON or YAML with a published JSON Schema, and export to HTML, XML, Markdown, SVG and Storybook.

Key facts for writing Tree Weaver data:

- Wrap documents as `{ "format": "tree-weaver", "version": 1, "tree": {...} }` or `"forest": {...}`.
- Ids, timestamps and `kind` are optional; the importer fills them in. A string in `children` is a text leaf.
- `styles` is keyed by display: `lg` (desktop large, the base), `xl`, `tablet`, `mobile-landscape`, `mobile-portrait`. Phones inherit tablet; everything inherits `lg`. Use kebab-case CSS properties with string values.
- Images are leaves (`{ "kind": "leaf", "type": "image", "value": url, "attrs": { "alt": "..." } }`), not `img` branches.
- SVG: a tree whose root has `"tag": "svg"` is a drawing. Shapes are leaves: `{ "type": "shape", "value": "circle", "attrs": { "cx": "50", "cy": "50", "r": "40" } }`, inside an `svg` branch; groups (`g`), `text`, `defs` and gradients are branches. SVG names keep their case (`viewBox`, `linearGradient`).
- No scripts, event handlers, SVG animation or `style` attributes. CSS goes in design kits (`forest.kits`).
- Check output with `npx tree-weaver validate file.json`, or `validateDocument` / `validateText` from the `tree-weaver` npm package; every issue has a path and a fix hint.
- The `tree-weaver` CLI also starts trees from templates (`new`), inserts library branches or JSON nodes by path (`add`, `outline`), applies patches (`patch`), expands shorthand (`expand`), converts formats (`convert`) and renders HTML (`render`).
- Shorthand saves tokens: `"h2: Title"`, `"a.btn[href=/join]: Join"`, `"@card"` (a library branch), `{ "grid": 3, "children": [...] }`, `{ "row": [...] }`, `{ "table": [["A", "B"], ["1", "2"]] }`, and flat `styles` (`{ "gap": "1rem", "tablet": {...} }`). Run `npx tree-weaver expand file.yaml -o file.json`.
- Edit with patches instead of rewriting: `[{ "op": "insert", "parent": "/1", "node": "h2: Pricing" }, { "op": "setStyles", "target": "b_x", "styles": { "padding": "2rem" } }]`, nodes named by id or path (`/2/0`), all or nothing: `npx tree-weaver patch file.json edits.json`.

## Docs

- [Format guide](https://github.com/hynding/tree-weaver/blob/main/docs/format.md): the model, displays and cascade, layout recipes, kits, validation
- [JSON Schema](https://hynding.github.io/tree-weaver/schema/tree-weaver-v1.schema.json): draft 2020-12 schema for forests, trees, branches, leaves and kits
- [CLI guide](https://github.com/hynding/tree-weaver/blob/main/docs/cli.md): `npx tree-weaver` commands, options, paths and exit codes
- [Shorthand](https://github.com/hynding/tree-weaver/blob/main/docs/shorthand.md): the compact authoring form and how it expands
- [Patches](https://github.com/hynding/tree-weaver/blob/main/docs/patch.md): edit operations, node references and checks; [patch JSON Schema](https://hynding.github.io/tree-weaver/schema/tree-weaver-patch-v1.schema.json)
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/hynding/tree-weaver/blob/main/AGENTS.md): working in the repository and integrating the packages
- [README](https://github.com/hynding/tree-weaver/blob/main/README.md): features, formats and deployment settings

## Examples

- [Minimal tree](https://github.com/hynding/tree-weaver/blob/main/examples/minimal.tree.json): smallest useful document, no ids
- [Landing page](https://github.com/hynding/tree-weaver/blob/main/examples/landing-page.tree.json): navbar, hero and a responsive feature grid
- [Pricing table](https://github.com/hynding/tree-weaver/blob/main/examples/pricing-table.tree.json): table markup with per-display styles
- [SVG logo](https://github.com/hynding/tree-weaver/blob/main/examples/logo.tree.json): an SVG tree with a gradient, a group and shape leaves
- [Landing page in shorthand](https://github.com/hynding/tree-weaver/blob/main/examples/landing-page.short.yaml): the same page in a fraction of the text
- [Landing page patch](https://github.com/hynding/tree-weaver/blob/main/examples/landing-page.patch.json): text, inserts, styles, classes and a removal by path
- [Small site forest](https://github.com/hynding/tree-weaver/blob/main/examples/site.forest.json): two trees, shared kits and custom class rules

## Optional

- [Live editor](https://hynding.github.io/tree-weaver/): open a JSON, YAML, XML, HTML, Markdown or SVG file with Upload
- [Source](https://github.com/hynding/tree-weaver): pnpm workspace, Stencil app in apps/web, libraries in packages/
